If there were ZERO I'd give it, but there isn't. They're thieves. They tricked me, supposedly doing an alignment on my car, but they scammed me out of $80.I called to find out how much the alignment would cost for my car. They told me $80. …
My second visit here in such a short time (hopefully the last!), and once again, they didn't disappoint. …

Dallas Collision Center did an amazing job on the repair of my vehicle. The front desk was very courteous and friendly. My advisor, Raz, was great to work with, he kept me informed on the progress of the repair, and was a pro throughout the process. The car looks great! I would recommend them to everyone!

I wanna give a big shout out to Melissa and her team. Was involved in a hit and run at my apartment. Melissa really made the repair process super easy for me and her team did an amazing job on my Honda it looks basically brand new again. …

If I could give more than 5 stars I would. John is the best, hands down honest and his integrity speaks volumes. Since finding John and his staff at this location I will never take my Range Rover anywhere else. I can’t tell you how much I thank everyone here for providing superior service. They are truly the best!

Had a great experience at European Service Center! I brought my car in to get the AC fixed. I really admired the sense of transparency they provided and felt like they went out of their way to provide terrific service at a terrific cost. Highly recommend.

Mechanics are very nice and the shop is transparent with pricing, but I would not recommend for tire service. Was charged a total of $450 for two $80 off-brand tires (no allignment, just swaped 2 tires). $60/tire to “mount and balance.”
I get that they need to charge for labor and service, but this was steep to me and likely +$100 than countless other shops in the area I could have gone to.

In summary: Great service, mid-high prices.

I had one of the most frustrating mechanic experiences at Lovefield Auto. I called ahead and spoke with Lloyd for 15 minutes, clearly explaining the issue—my 2020 Honda HR-V was diagnosed by the dealership with a bad right strut. He quoted me over $900 for the repair but said I had to wait a full week to bring the car in. Fine—I waited.

I dropped the car off promptly at 8AM. Radio silence until 2PM, when they finally said they test drove it but didn’t hear the sound. I told them: you have to turn the wheel—of course you won’t hear anything driving in a straight line. Two more hours passed. I had to call them back at 4:30PM for an update.

Then came the kicker: they told me they did finally hear the noise after turning the wheel—but said they weren’t sure what to do. Lloyd literally said they checked mechanic forums and Reddit and that fixing the strut might or might not solve the problem. A 50/50 chance, he said. They even mentioned it might be the shock, which doesn’t align at all with what I know or what the dealership diagnosed.

By 5PM (closing time), I was told the car “seems drivable” and that if the noise bothers me, I can come fix it—but they weren’t sure it would help. No confidence, no real diagnostic work, and zero follow-through. I felt completely brushed off and left with more questions than answers.

If you value your time, money, and peace of mind, go somewhere else. This shop wasted a week of my time and gave me nothing in return but confusion.

Did not have a good experience. We had to go back 3 times to get the issue fixed and Randy at Love Field Auto on Denton never even apologized or offered to cover the extra Ubers and they also left the coolant level quite low. Also said our brake pads needed replacing. That was a year ago and our brakes are still fine.

Went to Love Field Auto because of the online reviews. I have my own engine diagnostic so I knew my check engine light was an oxygen sensor. Randy also found that I needed new CV joints. Cost me $1300 and was out of there Tuesday evening. The check engine light came back on the next day on Wednesday. Randy had me bring it back in on Friday and on the way home the check engine came back on again. Do not recommend unless you want to spend a lot of money to not have your issue resolved.

Used to love Love Field Auto until a recently poor diagnosis. Very disappointed that a diagnosis for fluid on the bottom of my engine, was for a part that was UNDERNEATH said engine. It was obvious no more than 5 minutes were spent "diagnosing" my car, even the odometer in mileage was incorrect on the invoice, so it was apparent that there was a lack of care/effort put into it. $150 for a rush job is outrageous. A true diagnosis for a leak would have utilized UV fluid and a UV light to identify where it's coming from.

They have lost my trust and my recommendation from anyone near Love Field/DAL.

Called about getting all my brakes and rotors done as well as an oil change. I was given an estimate and told to bring my car in early so they could try to have me out of there by noon.
When I got there I said I’d be in their waiting area, to which I was told that the car most likely wasn’t going to be done until 4 in the evening. I asked the old man at the desk if he was the one I talked to on the phone, he said yea I told you it was going to be all day right? To which I replied, no I was told the afternoon and he responded with ya 4 o’clock. I just moved out here to Texas, so I don’t have anyone that could’ve given me a ride or picked me up, so that would’ve been nice to know.
After some time I was told the front was good but my aft rotors and brakes were shot. The price for that alone was a few $100 more than the estimate for all of them. Not sure if that included the oil change.
I had already been there for about 45 minutes so at that point before they started doing work. I asked if they could just order the parts for me and if we could reschedule so I wouldn’t have to sit there all day to which they said no because they didn’t want to sit on parts.
Probably would’ve started taking my car here. But after giving me a wrong estimate, being untrue with the time it would take to get the job done and not willing to help me out so I wouldn’t have to sit at the shop all day, I’m all set. I’m a mechanic as well but I wanted the convenience of not having to change them myself, so I’ll just get the parts and do it. Thanks anyways though

Randy seemed very nice when I brought my vehicle for inspection.  I called a few days later to clarify the replacement of components and ask if the price could be reduced. He gave me a snotty answer like , would you like my workers to work for free ? He wasn't very professional.  He could have just said , I wouldn't be able to because of inflation etc. So, I canceled by AC repair with his business.  Attitude matters for me no matter how good you are in your job.

My experience here is shocking considering how many recommendations I received to come here, and how many positive reviews have been left online.

I brought my car here to replace the headlights with LEDs that I bought. When I picked the car up I was surprised with how poorly they were installed. Massive gaps all the way around the lights. Asking Randy about it I was told, "that's just the way non OEM lights fit."

The first photo is one of the lights leaving Love Field Auto. The second photo is after 10 minutes with a service advisor at Sewell with a socket wrench. I ended up paying Sewell to redo the work and properly install the headlights - they fit perfect!

What's most concerning is the gaslighting over something so visually apparent with the car. I worry what happens in the places you can't see. I will not bring my car back to this shop.

Took my vehicle in for shocks and struts to be replaced and for a power steering issue to be addressed, and decided to get an oil change because it was about time for one.  He kept my car for three days and all they did was the oil change and my power steering is still messed up and the shocks and struts are still in need of replacement.  Wasted my time.  YMMV, but I would avoid this place at all costs.

I came here based on the positive reviews, but unfortunately, I did not have a good experience. I was charged $595 for them to replace 2 sensors and the cabin air filter. The knock sensor cost $150, but the air filter and oil sensor are $15 parts. So I was overcharged big time for a 1-2 hour job. They also told me I needed a new oxygen sensor, power steering pump, and serpentine belt, and they wanted to charge me another $770 to replace those.

I got a second opinion from a different mechanic shop, and they couldn't find ANY code from the computer when they plugged in the diagnostic reader. They looked at the power steering pump and told me it was in good shape, I just had some residue from a previous leak that I had fixed in the past.

Several months after my first visit the knock sensor code came back, and they said the sensor "had come loose," so they "tightened it back up," whatever that means. Now another few months have gone by, and the code is back again. Who knows if they even changed the sensor in the first place. When I returned and told them the knock sensor was still not fixed they refused to attend me because they saw I had posted a negative review. They were extremely offended that I would not give them 5 stars.

Normally they offer all customers coupons and discounts in exchange for a 5 star review... That is why they appear to have positive ratings. This is a dishonest way to do business.

For an affordable and honest mechanic, I would recommend PV Auto.

Edit to owner response: Am I sure I have the right company? Of course I'm sure, would you like me to send you a copy of the receipt and the complaint I filed against you on the Better Business Bureau? Of course, it makes sense that your record keeping is as shoddy as your repairs.
They charged 1k to fix absolutely nothing the part that they reassured me was the issue wasn’t. After taking the car back to have them right their wrong all they did was reset my check engine light.

I explained the issues going on with the car and what I thought to be the issue (fuel injector) when i dropped it off. Randy met me with cheeky remarks. "So you googled the symptoms and that's what it told you." "So do you want me to check the fuel injector or do you want me to check the car?"

I also feel like Randy withheld the fact that the issues I had explained to him were due to the transmission going bad. Before they did the work, he only told me it was due to motor mounts and control arm bushings. It wasn't until after they fixed those that he revealed the transmission was going bad. He would've/should've known that from the beginning because you experience the issues every time you drive the car. So now I'm out $1,500 and the issue I took my car there for was not fixed. This definitely seemed shady and dishonest for sure.

I tought is important for you guys to know about this before taking your car here. There's a few lessons I learn on my way. I took my car here the first time after looking at the review for the a/c check.
After taking it there they told me it was "low on freon" and a seal was leaking.
After a few days the a/c started failing again, something wasn't right. You will think is something they probably haven't check or forgot so you take it back again expecting them to get it fix it correctly this time.
Now they told me the their machine is broken (isn't my fault), and they need to adjust the a/c freon.
The car suppose to have an exact amount of a/c freon weight on the hood, so it shouldn't be hard for them to fill up. But they also without asking me when and procede to change the air filter (that I replace less than 10k miles ago). Without asking.
And charged me $32 for another filter that I'm sure don't need.And I'm sure isn't even a factory replacement neither and is a cheap aftermarket.
I don't mind to pay, but as long as I'm asked first.
Because at the end of the day end up being from a $140 fixing a $5 seal + refill and now add the refill again and the "$32".
So what it supposed to be a "no charge correct fix this time"
Now my bill is running over $170 for something I would rather do myself.
Not everybody gave $32 dollar to spend like that. Sometimes people live check by check and charging them $32 for something they don't need or they cannot afford at the moment isn't fair.
Another thing is the car is a manual transmission, when I went to pick it up the car was parked on the lot right next the shop. Without the parking brake on and in neutral? My car could have roll over hitting another car or somebody.
They need to be more careful about how they leave the cars in the parking and if the machine is "malfunctioning" they should call back all the clients that may be affected by this issue and not wait until the client need to loose a day from work to having to go back to get the stuff done twice.
Is really frustrating because I have issues having a mechanic around in this city that I'm new in finding a mechanic to trust and my first experience with them is a Rocky one. Is such a bad impression and bad experience. Is this incident really make me feel comfortable to come back?

I was recommended here by a neighbor who said they did really great A/C work in the dead of summer when your A/C is out.  I had a little more minor but urgent work done.

Ok, the shop itself is very claustrophobic especially since most will have to sit and wait a long time because he continues to let cars pile up instead of just telling people he can't get to it that day and bring it back another day.
Many of us can't leave our cars there with him for nights on end as it's out only form of transportation.

As such, the ventilation was poor.  I have respiratory issues and had to get up and get fresh air as I waited and waited, something that I never have to do at other repair shops.

I had an appt and still had to wait.  He told me it would be xy amount of hours, but it ended up being a lot less than that.  I think if you stay with your car they tend to work on it faster than if you leave it there it will just sit as he takes in and services all those oil changes that comes in so much later than you, just to get that extra hustle going.

I find his prices are not competitive.  When I called around, he costed more than most that I called.  The repair that I needed was asap, I didn't have time to call around before but only after on a hunch.
He is semi-friendly, kind of looks at you funny at first, but I guess he warms to you a bit as you are sitting there patiently.  I'm not sure I would use him again.  I can go to Firestone for quicker service,  because his prices are similar to theirs.

Even with Warranty Protection Plus this service center would not replace purchased parts from defects. Returned my car 3 times and was told “blows cold just fine” even though it never did when I picked up the car each time? Just going to Firestone like I should have originally to fix my a/c

My son took his car to diagnose a service light issue that was preventing him from passing inspection. They told my son that $800 worth of stuff needs to be replaced to fix this issue. $800 later, the light was still there. They told my son that now they figured it out - it needs another part, another $400. It is their failure not meeting the objective the 1st time around. The best case scenario - they are simply incompetent, the worst case scenario- it is a scam by a very unprofessional thieving mechanics taking advantage of a kid who can not afford this kind of a thing. Bottom line - I would not trust or recommend this business based on our experience...

Response to owner's question. If you are Love Field Auto on Denton in Dallas, then yes - this feedback is for you! But nice try at denial...

Brake replacement was >$400. That could be a decent price, I just don't know. I was then offered to make more repairs and replacements totaling $800, the mechanic failed to explain why it had to be done and which of them are crucial for safety (something tells me that none). He looked irritated that I asked too many questions.

Cherry on the top was that they suggested I spend $1300 for new suspension. For the record that would be more than a half of what I paid for my 2006 Sentra.

People may have had good experience with this shop, but I felt treated like a dummy with a lot of extra cash.

Hello Owner, I had the white 1997 Honda wagon which you worked on 1/2 dozen times. Overcharged for your work. Never resolved issues on the vehicle. Stand-by my original review.  Warning All potential customers to Not patron your garage.

I see all these good reviews but it doesn't mean anything. I took my 08 expo to them bcus ac wasn't blowing cold. Kevin calls me the next day and says the condenser is the problem. Labor/parts $700. I say this will make ac blow cold again. He says yup. Go pick up truck after I paid.Kevin says well this might fix the ac seeing that this is a older truck there could be a leak somewhere else.smh ..Three days later ac is hot again took it to another shop they fixed it. Feron was leaking from valve on ac line,simple fix. They hustled me for 700 dollars thanks kevin.

Was referred here after another company to remain unnamed, messed up a tire stud. When I left, I had a mismatched stud for the replacement and they broke one of the other studs. Would not recommend to anyone.

Manager was rude,did not apologize or correct himself! Great professional customer service is number one with me! I did not do business with them! FYI: positive reviews can be manipulated!
